hero.heading: ZFS and Btrfs, shares and backups that restore.
hero.lead: Pools, shares, S3 buckets, databases and backups in one place. Reef watches your disks, runs your scrubs and tells you before something fails.

visual.summary: 2.5 TB of 4 TB · ZFS mirror · last scrub 3 days ago, 0 errors

capabilities.heading: Storage you can trust with your photos.

items.title: Pools
items.body: ZFS and Btrfs pools: mirrors, RAIDZ, RAID1, with a guided layout picker.

items.title: Snapshots
items.body: Scheduled snapshots with retention rules, browsable from the console.

items.title: Shares
items.body: SMB with Time Machine support and NFS, with users and permissions from Crustates.

items.title: S3 buckets
items.body: S3-compatible object storage with Garage, for apps and backups.

items.title: Backups
items.body: Incremental, deduplicated, encrypted backups of VMs and apps with rustic, to disk, S3 or another node.

items.title: Restore drills
items.body: Test-restore a backup to a scratch volume on a schedule, so you know it works.

items.title: Databases
items.body: Managed PostgreSQL for apps, with users, extensions and point-in-time restore.

items.title: Disk health
items.body: SMART monitoring, scrubs and alerts before a disk fails.

items.title: Encryption at rest
items.body: ZFS native encryption or LUKS under Btrfs, unlocked by the TPM.

how.heading: Volumes are resources, not mount points.
how.lead: Apps and VMs ask for a volume. Reef creates it on the right pool, snapshots it and backs it up by policy.

steps.title: Create a pool
steps.body: Pick disks in the console; Reef proposes a layout and checks for data on them.

steps.title: Attach volumes
steps.body: A VM disk or app volume becomes a zvol or Btrfs subvolume.

steps.title: Set a policy
steps.body: Snapshot and backup schedules, retention and targets per volume or app.

steps.title: Restore any time
steps.body: Roll back a snapshot or restore a backup to a new volume.

faq.title: ZFS or Btrfs?
faq.body: ZFS for mirrors and RAIDZ with matching disks; Btrfs for mixed disk sizes and simpler setups. Both are first-class.

faq.title: Can I import an existing pool?
faq.body: Yes. Reef detects existing ZFS and Btrfs pools and imports them without touching data.

faq.title: Where should backups go?
faq.body: At least one copy off the box: S3, another node or a friend's Crustates.

faq.title: Is there a managed database?
faq.body: Yes, PostgreSQL. Apps from the catalog can ask for one and get credentials as secrets.
